sourceText:
Polvorones
By: Moonglow
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:56pm

Ingredients




1 cup butter
 cup sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla
1/2 teaspoon almond extract
2 cups flour
1 cup finely chopped
Nuts
Powdered sugar

Preparation

1 In large bowl beat the butter and sugar until fluffy. Add vanilla and almond extract and beat well. Stir in flour and nuts. Cover and chill 1 hour. 2 Shape into 1 inch balls. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until lightly brown. Cool 5 minutes then roll in powdered sugar. Cool thoroughly, then roll in powdered sugar again. Makes approximately 60.
